scenes.synopsis: the morning after the libel war — the winning hand, counted; the Season opens. (Turns: 8)

> *(Morning, and the Gazette folded on the breakfast tray like a receipt. The Lantern is broken. Three weeks of gutter ink, answered in the open and answered clean, and Mrs. Nance Bell's verdict sits at the column's foot in her own dry hand: the town has read it all, and the town has made up its mind. Rose Hartwell, the woman the libel couldn't kill. She pours chocolate and counts her winnings the way Augusta taught her — once for the sum, once for the nerve.)*
> "Read it again, darling. I want to watch your face do the arithmetic." — Letitia

> "It was won in the open. That is the whole of it." — Rose
> (T2 · tone) *quiet — the victory, held steady; dry — the Hartwell refusal to preen; bright — the Season, opening like a door.* — remembered: *She refuses the preen.*
> "The town made up its mind, my love, which is rarer than being right." — Letitia

> (T4 · stance) *as the victor — steady, the hand won; as the soldier — the war, not the battle, is the point; as the Hartwell — winnings are for spending.* — remembered: *She spends forward.*

> (T6 · social maneuver) *set the household's tone — victory, worn lightly; set the aunt's — let her preen a little; set her own — the work ahead, priced.* — remembered: *The tone, set.*
> (T7 · look closer) *the chocolate — cooling, the morning's one patience; the window — London, the Season's first light; the tray — the paper's fold, exact, like a hand of cards laid down.* — remembered: *The morning, read.*

scenes.synopsis: the library — first sight; dust, the paper memory, the war room's raw material. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(The library has been waiting. Three generations of Hartwell paper, shelved in the order in which life happened to it — which is to say, no order at all. Dust lies on the high shelves like a second, greyer set of books. The desk is vast. The light from the tall windows falls on the blotter in a clean parallelogram, and Rose stands in the doorway and understands, all at once, that this room is the campaign's true headquarters, and that it has been waiting for someone to say so.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *the shelves — three generations, unsorted; the dust — the grey second library, undisturbed; the desk — vast, the blotter's clean parallelogram of light.* — remembered: *The room, surveyed.*
> (T2 · remembered micro-decision) *open a window — the dust, disturbed at last; leave the dust — the archive's dignity; sneeze — the archive's welcome.* — remembered: *The window, opened.*
> (T3 · stance) *as the heir — the paper, inherited; as the general — the room, claimed; as the scholar — the shelves, read at a glance.* — remembered: *The room, claimed.*
> (T4 · tone) *reverent — the generations, shelved; practical — the sorting, priced; delighted — the campaign's true headquarters, found.* — remembered: *The delight, filed.*
> (T5 · look closer) *the blotter — the light's parallelogram, exact; the inkstand — dry, the pen's long retirement; the chair — the general's, awaiting its general.* — remembered: *The desk, readied.*
> (T6 · social maneuver) *with the dust — "You have had your century; it is mine now." (unsaid); with the shelves — the generations, greeted; with the room — the headquarters, declared.* — remembered: *The declaration, made.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *touch nothing yet — the survey, complete first; touch everything — the hunger, admitted; touch the desk — the claim, physical.* — remembered: *The desk, touched.*
> (T8 · choice) *begin with Rackham — the instrument's leavings; begin with the old ledgers — the family's own memory; begin with the windows — light first, paper second.* — remembered: *Rackham, first.*
> *(She touches the desk. The wood is cool under her palm, the blotter's parallelogram of light exact as a map's border, and the dust — disturbed at last by the opened window — turns slowly in the sunbeam like something considering whether to settle again. It will not settle. She has decided. The library is no longer a room where books are kept. It is a room where paper is interrogated, and the paper had better have its answers ready.)*
> *The chair waits. The inkstand is dry. The shelves hold three generations of unsorted life, and Rose stands among them the way a general stands on a surveyed field — and smiles, because the field is hers, and the enemy has been kind enough to leave his papers behind.*

scenes.synopsis: Augusta's counsel — what the winning hand bought, and what paper costs. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(Augusta's morning room. The Dowager has read the Gazette, folded it with more precision than the paper deserves, and now regards her granddaughter over the spectacles with the expression of a woman pricing a victory she did not pay for.)*

> (T2 · tone) *steady — the victory, held; dry — "More interesting than the libel, Grandmama?"; grave — the watching, understood.* — remembered: *She holds steady.*
> "The Network is done hiding behind cutouts, Rose. The gutter failed them. They will not use the gutter twice." — Augusta
> (T3 · remembered micro-decision) *note the name — the Network, spoken plainly; note the warning — the gutter, retired as a weapon; file both — intelligence, priced.* — remembered: *The warning, filed.*
> (T4 · stance) *as the soldier — the next weapon, anticipated; as the granddaughter — the counsel, received; as the Hartwell — the open, preferred.* — remembered: *The counsel, taken.*
> "And the library?" — Rose
> (T5 · dialogue) *"And the library — what does it cost me?"; "The paper remembers, Grandmama — what does it charge?"; "Tell me what the library is for."* — remembered: *The question, asked.*
> "Paper remembers everything, child, and charges nothing until you need it to forget. Then it is ruinous." — Augusta
> (T6 · look closer) *the phrase — paper remembers; the price — forgetting, ruinous; the Dowager — who has paid it, once.* — remembered: *The price, noted.*
> (T7 · social maneuver) *as the pupil — the lesson, taken; as the heir — the library, accepted as inheritance; as the campaigner — the cost, budgeted.* — remembered: *The budget, set.*

> *(She curtsies. The spectacles rise, the dismissal is complete, and the morning room releases her back to her own headquarters — which is smaller, dustier, and entirely hers. Paper remembers everything. She climbs toward the library thinking of the price of forgetting, and of the Dowager's face when she named it — the face of a woman who has paid it, once, and never speaks of the receipt.)*
> *The staircase is short and the counsel is long, and Rose carries it the way she carries everything Augusta gives her: carefully, like a loaded pistol, with the safety understood to be entirely theoretical.*

> (T2 · tone) *wry — "Afraid the library offers none of those."; gentle — the soldier, honored; direct — "There is no lawful authority, Henry."* — remembered: *The honesty, given.*
> "That is what troubles me. There is no magistrate to carry this to, no commission, no colors. I was trained for wars with shapes." — Henry
> (T3 · remembered micro-decision) *hear the trouble — duty, the honest kind; name it — love against duty, the lane's divide; hold it — the soldier, the man, the friend.* — remembered: *The divide, named.*
> (T4 · stance) *as the friend — his trouble, permitted; as the campaigner — the shapeless war, defended; as the woman — the man, not the uniform.* — remembered: *The man, seen.*
> "Then love me into a shapeless war, or love me out of it. Those are the shapes on offer." — Rose
> (T5 · dialogue) *"Love me into it, or out of it."; "The war has no shape — I do. Hold to that."; "Duty never had to be tidy, Henry — only kept."* — remembered: *The shapes, offered.*
> (T6 · social maneuver) *show him the boxes — the terrain, shared; keep him in the doorway — the soldier, stationed; ask his counsel — the map table, used.* — remembered: *The counsel, sought.*
> (T7 · look closer) *his face — the duty, the love, the arithmetic; the mud — drying on the boots, the daylight's; the boxes — the unopened, the waiting.* — remembered: *The arithmetic, witnessed.*

> *(He holds to her. The mud dries on his boots, the library's dust turns in the light, and the unopened boxes sit between them like a map table neither of them can quite read yet — but he has chosen his shape, and it is her, and the choosing is the whole of the lane. > (T2 · tone) *honest — "I don't know yet."; dry — "Winning, Octavia. The for comes later."; thoughtful — the question, turned over.* — remembered: *The honesty, given.*
> "Everyone else asks how. Julian asks if you'll survive it. Laurent asks if it can be survived beautifully. Henry asks if it's lawful." She smiles. "I am asking what it's for." — Octavia
> (T3 · remembered micro-decision) *hear the catalogue — the lanes, divided; hear the smile — the friendship, the love; hear the question — the for, unanswered.* — remembered: *The catalogue, kept.*
> (T4 · stance) *as the friend — the question, permitted; as the campaigner — the for, postponed; as the woman — the not-knowing, admitted.* — remembered: *The not-knowing, owned.*
> "If the answer is vengeance, say so now, and I shall still sit here. But say it." — Octavia
> (T5 · dialogue) *"It isn't vengeance."; "It might be. I haven't decided."; "It's the Park. It's always been the Park."* — remembered: *The answer, attempted.*
> (T6 · social maneuver) *let her sketch — the painter, permitted; stop her — the sitting, refused; ask her — "What do you see?"* — remembered: *The painter, asked.*
> (T7 · look closer) *her eyes — the seeing, the painter's; the unopened book — the portrait, postponed; the friendship — the courage to name the cost.* — remembered: *The courage, noted.*

> *Octavia rises, the sketchbook still unopened, and touches Rose's shoulder as she passes — the painter's benediction, the friend's — and the door closes on the question, which stays.*

scenes.synopsis: the Season's opening — gown intelligence from the fashion column; the Directresses' eye, considered. (Turns: 8)

scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — THE LIBRARY (the war room's founding order). How Rose organizes the paper memory. (Turns: 3 — the decision)
scenes.prose:
> *(Evening. The library's lamps are lit, the three boxes stand open at last — the tape cut in a small ceremony with Letitia holding the lamp like an acolyte — and Rackham's papers lie across the desk in the clerk's non-order, which is to say, the order of a thorough man's chaos. Beyond them, the shelves: three generations of Hartwell paper, waiting for their general. The war room is founded tonight. The only question is the order of battle.)*
> *(She stands among it all with a pencil behind her ear and Augusta's phrase in her head — paper remembers everything — and understands that how she sorts the memory is how she will fight the war. The debtors. The dates. The London interests. Three orders of battle, and the lamp burning, and Letitia — holding the lamp, the acolyte — waiting to see which general her niece intends to be.)*
> *(The destination is fixed — the Network's money, mapped; who profited from the Hartwells' ruin; what the principal wants next — but the means are hers. She prices them: by debtor — every name that ever owed or was owed, the human map, the grudges and the gratitudes; by date — the ruin's chronology, the speculation's seasons, cause laid beside effect like bodies on a field; by London interest — the money's present tense, where it sits now, who holds it, what it wants next. Each order finds different truths. Each makes a different war.)*
*★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — The library:*
- **By debtor** — *The human map.* Every name that owed or was owed; grudges and gratitudes, filed where she can find them.
- **By date** — *The ruin's chronology.* Cause beside effect, season by season; the speculation's anatomy, laid bare.
- **By London interest** — *The money's present tense.* Where it sits now, who holds it, what it wants next; the war as it stands.
> *(The game remembers the choice — and the means: the human map, the chronology, or the present tense. The library is founded on her order. The paper will remember it her way.)*

The Network doesn't send notes — Lavinia said they send weather, and Letitia said the Network's stationery cupboard, and Augusta said nothing at all, which is Augusta's way of saying the most. Open it now and know. Burn it unread and be free of it. Lock it away and let the war decide the hour. Three dispositions, and the wax entire in all of them — because the seal is not hers to break on curiosity's schedule. The note will be opened when the war requires it. The only question is where it waits until then.)*

- **Lock it in the desk** — *The headquarters' keeping.* The campaign's drawer; paper remembers, and so will she.
- **Burn it unread** — *The discipline of refusal.* The cleanest answer to an anonymous hand; no hook, no handle.
- **Carry it in the reticule** — *The weight, kept close.* Through the Season's weeks, against her hip; the reminder that someone is writing.

scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 3/3 — THE FIRST VERDICT (answering the Season's opening judgment). The nod is given; how Rose carries it is the decision. (Turns: 3 — the decision)
scenes.prose:
> *(A week of the Season gone: the nod filed, the name spoken, the map drawn, the note sealed in its drawer. The town has read the papers and the town reads everything, and the town has made up its opening mind — the Directress's cool nod, Bell's arch approval, the empty chair at the opera. The Season's first verdict is in. It is favorable. It is also, Rose understands with the clarity of the second week, a leash — favorable verdicts have to be fed, and the town will watch forever to see if she was worth the nod.)*
> *(She stands at the library window with the week's reckoning in her hands and prices the carryings: wear it coolly — the verdict as armor, the town's good opinion held at arm's length, never fed, never courted; wear it warmly — the gladness accepted, the town's affection courted in return, the leash worn like a ribbon; wear it past — the verdict as yesterday's news, the campaign's true work the only answer, the town left to read what it likes. Each carrying is a different Season. Each is hers to choose.)*
> *(The destination is fixed — the confrontation coming, the account to be stated, the principal to be faced — but the weeks before it are hers to walk in her own manner. Augusta would say conduct. Letitia would say savor. Octavia would ask what it's for. She stands at the window with the Season's first verdict in her hands like a hand of cards, and chooses how to play it.)*
*★ KEY DECISION 3/3 — The first verdict:*
- **Wear it coolly** — *The verdict as armor.* The town's good opinion, held at arm's length; never fed, never courted.
- **Wear it warmly** — *The gladness, accepted.* The town's affection, courted in return; the leash worn like a ribbon.
- **Wear it past** — *Yesterday's news.* The campaign's true work the only answer; the town left to read what it likes.
> *(The game remembers the choice — and the means: the armor, the ribbon, or the past. The verdict is carried her way through the Season's weeks.)*

scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 3/3 — THE SCATTERED PAPER (the paper's market: buy, let lie, or burn the trade). The acquirer wants it suppressed. (Turns: 3 — the decision)
scenes.prose:
> *(The City's edge, evening: the counting-house's street behind her, the brass read and unread both — the reading done, the aloud held for its time. The scattered paper's market waits: the auction houses' lots, the private hands, the strongboxes. The acquirer wants it suppressed. The question the week demands: what does she do with the paper's market?)*
*★ KEY DECISION 3/3 — The scattered paper:*
- **Buy the lots** — *race him openly.* She enters the auction houses' records rooms and bids — the émigré notes, the Hartwell paper, the mortgages' paper. The suppression, suppressed. The market, raced in daylight. *Consequence:* the prices climb — the lively market loves two buyers; the Drummond installment's hanging pinches; but the paper comes home, lot by lot, and the bell's erasure is answered with ownership.
- **Let the lots lie** — *buy only the Hartwell paper.* She leaves the émigré notes to the market and buys only what bears the Hartwell name — the house's own paper, the Park's. The trade, not hers. The house, hers. *Consequence:* the purse stretches further — the Hartwell lots cost less than the whole trade; but the émigré notes go to the acquirer's buyers, and the trade's memory goes with them, and the bell keeps the rest.
- **Burn the trade** — *buy it to bury it.* She buys the scattered paper — all of it — and buries it: the notes, the ledgers, the trade, bought up and locked in the war room's boxes. Not suppressed — kept. The paper's memory, hers. *Consequence:* the war room's boxes grow heavy — the paper's memory becomes the house's burden; the purse empties fastest; but nothing is burned, nothing is buried by him, and the remembering is entire.
> *(She does the reckoning once for the sum, once for the nerve — and the market is chosen, and the paper's fate is set: the raced, the Hartwell-only, or the buried-kept. The brass shines behind her. The lots wait ahead. The fifth week holds its breath — and the buying begins.)*

scenes.synopsis: the great ball gown ritual — the ballroom's face; direction + twenty 5-coin pins (21 turns). The gown for the Season's great ball, the war still undeclared. (Turns: 21)
scenes.prose:
> **Occasion brief (published):** "The Season's great ball, tonight. The dress code: the ballroom's face — severe, solvent propriety; nothing to doubt, nothing to pity, nothing that apologizes. The gown must hold its own at the Season's glittering center and read, at twenty paces, as a woman who cannot be bought and will not be pitied. Mourning colors forbidden; gloves expected. **Editorial criterion: nerve.**"
>
> **A. The Solvent** — silver-grey silk; unhurried respectability with its spine showing. Motif: the ledger line, worked fine at the hem — nerve, itemized. Thread: **silver** (the solvent, stated) / **pewter silk** (the solvent, warmed) / **whitework** (the solvent, lit). Colorway: silver-grey + pearl + candlelight. Accessories: the pearl drop earrings; a simple silver pendant; grey kid gloves; no jewels that outshine the arithmetic.
> **B. The Landed** — deep green velvet; the Park's own color, worn in London like a flag. Motif: the Hartwell oak sprig, restrained at cuff and hem — the landed, stated. Thread: **gold** (the landed, gilded) / **copper** (the Park's autumn) / **matching silk** (the sober, exact). Colorway: deep green + Hartwell blue + cream. Accessories: the Hartwell blue ribbon at the throat; pearl drop earrings; a simple gold pendant; cream kid gloves.
> **C. The Glitter** — ivory crape with gold thread; the ballroom's own glitter, worn like a remark. Motif: the candle-flame, worked in gold at the hem — nerve, illuminated. Thread: **gold** (the glitter, stated) / **bronze** (the glitter, deepened) / **copper-gilt** (the glitter, warmed). Colorway: ivory + gold + shadow. Accessories: the gold ribbon at the throat; small gold hoop earrings; a simple pearl pendant; white kid gloves.
>
> *(System: commit to a direction — remembered for the great ball. Then the pins begin. Each pin costs 5 coins; no Crown SKUs; jewels from owned pieces only, never a ritual step.)*
>
> (T1 · choice — the direction) *She commits: A, B, or C — the ballroom's thesis, remembered.*
>
> **Pin 1 (T2 · micro-decision) — Dress silhouette:** the ball gown's line — empire, unhurried; nothing that apologizes. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 2 (T3 · micro-decision) — Bodice cut:** the ballroom's architecture — fitted, honest, the nerve's foundation. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 3 (T4 · micro-decision) — Bodice fabric:** silk, velvet, or fine crape — the honest evening weaves. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 4 (T5 · micro-decision) — Bodice color:** the direction's ground — silver-grey, deep green, or ivory — nerve's canvas. *5 coins.*
>
> *(Story morsel: Élise's girl, folding tissue: "The workroom says the corner, miss — the card room's corner. The chair is never empty, miss. The glasses sit on its arm like they own it.")*
>
> **Pin 5 (T6 · micro-decision) — Sleeve style:** the evening sleeve — short, composed; nothing that flutters under fire. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 6 (T7 · micro-decision) — Sleeve fabric:** to match or to contrast — the sleeve's quiet argument. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 7 (T8 · micro-decision) — Sleeve color:** the direction's echo at the wrist — silver, green, or ivory-gold. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 8 (T9 · micro-decision) — Neckline:** the honest neckline — modest, unhurried, giving nothing away. *5 coins.*
>
> *(Story morsel: Letitia's voice through the bedroom door, laying down the law: "The great ball, darling — the Season's own. Never be the hungriest person in the room, never be the loudest, never let them see you count the candles. The rest is improvisation, darling.")*
>
> **Pin 9 (T10 · micro-decision) — Skirt style:** the ballroom sweep — full, unhurried, the waltz's own length. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 10 (T11 · micro-decision) — Skirt fabric:** the evening's drape — silk that moves like good manners. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 11 (T12 · micro-decision) — Skirt color:** the ground, continued — the room will read it at twenty paces. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 12 (T13 · micro-decision) — Trim:** the direction's motif — the ledger line, the oak sprig, or the candle-flame — worked in the chosen thread. *5 coins.*
>
> *(Story morsel: the morning Gazette, read aloud over the pinning — the verdict on yesterday's promenade, arch and not unkind. "Bell is watching, miss. Bell is always watching.")*
>
> **Pin 13 (T14 · micro-decision) — Shoes:** evening slippers — quiet on a ballroom floor, sure in the waltz. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 14 (T15 · micro-decision) — Gloves:** expected, and immaculate — the evening's gauntlets. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 15 (T16 · micro-decision) — Hair:** the evening's architecture — dressed high, composed, the nerve's crown. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 16 (T17 · micro-decision) — Hair piece:** the direction's punctuation — silver comb, Hartwell blue ribbon, or gold. *5 coins.*
>
> *(Story morsel: a card slipped under the door, Augusta's hand — "Nerve, child. Not armor. The corner is watched; let it watch you back." She pins it inside the wardrobe door, where she will see it last.)*
>
> **Pin 17 (T18 · micro-decision) — Reticule:** the evening's small armory — the dance card, the pencil, the pocket's tomorrow. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 18 (T19 · micro-decision) — Shawl:** the carriage shawl — the night's, the kept. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 19 (T20 · micro-decision) — Scent:** the evening's signature — orange-flower water, the ballroom's own. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 20 (T21 · micro-decision) — The face:** the ballroom's face — composed, solvent, unhurried; the girl in the glass, the ball's. *5 coins.*
>
> *(The reveal: the gown, the ballroom's face, on. The girl in the glass — severe, solvent, unhurried — the Season's great ball met on its own terms. The coda: the ballroom waits, the corner is watched, the war undeclared, and the girl in the glass lifts her chin one degree and goes. The dressing-for-climax ends. The glass releases her.)*

> **Occasion brief (published):** "The sixteenth week — the answers, answered. Almack's, the subscription assembly: the ton, entire, watching. The dress code: solvent nerve — the called obligations paid, and paid publicly; nothing to hide, nothing to prove, nothing that reaches for pity or pardon. The dress must carry the week in a single line: the standing spent like coin, the open's whole arithmetic. White or the lightest colors; gloves required; no hoops. **Editorial criterion: solvent nerve.**"
>
> **A. The Open** — white muslin evening dress; the open's color, the daylight's, the called paid in the color of innocence. Motif: the straight hem — the honest line, worked plain: nerve, declared. Thread: **matching white** (the open, exact) / **silver** (the open, lit) / **pearl** (the open, softened). Colorway: white + candlelight + declaration. Accessories: a simple pearl brooch; pearl drop earrings; no pendant — the throat, plain; white kid gloves, immaculate. The reticule: the receipt, folded small, the paying's own voucher.

Thread: **pale blue** (the solvent, exact) / **silver** (the solvent, lit) / **steel** (the solvent, deepened). Colorway: pale blue + candlelight + solvency. scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — THE FIRST STRIKE (which paper to buy first: the émigré notes, the Bath house's pages, or the broker's bundle). The race is run; decide the strike's shape. (Turns: 3 — the decision)
scenes.prose:
> *(The war room, midday: the map, the pins, the buying's three roads. The larger is buying the same paper; the first strike must land where it matters most.)*
> "Buy first where it hurts them, not where it comforts you." — Mr. Silas Vane (the agent's whole counsel, delivered standing, the list folded in his hand)
> *(Three roads. The paper is the material, the race the weather, the buying continues — but the first strike is hers to choose. She prices them: the émigré notes — the quiet money's paper, the de Valcourt trail's own ink, bought from the émigré houses before the larger's buyers arrive; the Bath pages — the banker's ledger pages, the Bath house's record of what Rackham signed, bought clean and witnessed; the broker's bundle — the cutout's whole holding, bought entire, the turning and the buying in one stroke. Each road buys paper. Each seasons the war differently.)*
*★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — The first strike:*
- **Strike at the émigré notes** — *Noted, bought.* She buys the quiet money's paper first — the émigré houses' notes, the trail's own ink. *(The buying lands closest to the larger's heart, and the larger will feel it first; but the émigré houses sell slowly, and slowly is a kind of telling.)*
- **Strike at the Bath pages** — *Paged, bought.* She buys the Bath house's ledger pages first — witnessed, clean, the solicitor at her elbow. *(The buying is the cleanest, the armor most complete; but the Bath house's pages prove the least, and the larger will call it caution.)*
- **Strike at the broker's bundle** — *Bundled, bought.* She buys the cutout's whole holding entire — the turning and the buying in one stroke. *(The buying turns the broker with the bundle, two birds with one purse; but the cutout's paper is the dirtiest, and dirt has a way of showing.)*
> *(The game remembers the choice, and the means: the noted, the paged, or the bundled. The destination was never in doubt. The signature is hers.)*

scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 3/3 — THE FIRST BLOOD (how the offensive shows itself: quiet, daylight, or the market's talk). The buying is done; decide the blood's shape. (Turns: 3 — the decision)
scenes.prose:
> *(The war room, evening: the bought paper stacked, the ledger closed, the larger outbid. How the first blood shows itself is hers to choose.)*
> "Bought open cannot be unbought, darling. But quiet bought can be denied — and denied is a kind of unbuying." — Letitia (the hawk's whole counsel, delivered over the teacups, the second list folded away)
> *(Three roads. The buying is the material, the showing the weather, the offensive continues — but the means are hers to choose. She prices them: the quiet — show nothing, let the larger wonder where its paper went, the war room's triumph a private arithmetic; the daylight — show everything, buy at the bankers' doors in the open, the City watching the outbidding; the market's talk — let the market talk, the buying seen and spoken of, Bell's Gazette reporting what the City saw, the paper judging the spectacle. Each road shows the blood. Each seasons the war differently.)*
*★ KEY DECISION 3/3 — The first blood:*
- **Show it quiet** — *Quiet, shown.* She shows nothing — the larger left to wonder where its paper went. *(The showing keeps the war room's triumph private, and privacy is its own armor; but quiet bought can be denied, and denied is a kind of unbuying.)*
- **Show it in daylight** — *Daylit, shown.* She buys at the bankers' doors in the open — the City watching. *(The showing spends standing like coin, and the daylight is the whole doctrine; but the daylight spends the purse faster, and the larger watches too.)*
- **Let the market talk** — *Talked, shown.* She lets the market talk — the buying seen, Bell reporting what the City saw. *(The showing lets the Gazette judge the spectacle, and the paper's verdict is the ton's weather; but the paper judges, it does not serve, and Bell's gavel falls where it falls.)*
> *(The game remembers the choice, and the means: the quiet, the daylit, or the talked. The destination was never in doubt. The signature is hers.)*

scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — THE SQUEEZE MET (how she meets the financing squeeze: the purse quietly, the standing openly, or the works paused). The answer is the material; decide the meeting's shape. (Turns: 3 — the decision)
scenes.prose:
> *(The war room, midday: the map, the pins, the financing's three roads. The restoration's obligations called early; the master mason's yard stops unless the squeeze is met.)*
> "Meet it the way you met the masquerade, child — as yourself, and in daylight. But the means are the question." — Augusta (the Dowager's whole counsel, delivered standing, the spectacles already risen)
> *(Three roads. The squeeze is the material, the week the weather, the answering continues — but the meeting is hers to choose. She prices them: the purse — pay the obligations quietly from her own purse, the yard kept whole, no eyes on the spending; the standing — borrow openly against her standing, in daylight, spend standing like coin where the ton can see it; the pause — let the works pause and answer the Network instead of the paper, the squeeze faced as a challenge, not a bill. Each road meets the squeeze. Each seasons the war differently.)*
*★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — The squeeze met:*
- **Pay the obligations quietly from her own purse** — *Purse, opened.* She meets the squeeze with her own money — the yard kept whole, no eyes on the spending. *(The meeting keeps the war's arithmetic private, and the mason's men never know the danger; but quiet is quiet, and the ton will read the pause as the squeeze winning.)*
- **Borrow openly against her standing, in daylight** — *Standing, spent.* She borrows against her standing publicly — spend standing like coin, in daylight, where the ton can see it. *(The meeting shows the solvency entire, and the Network learns the squeeze did not bend her; but open is open, and the standing spent is the standing risked.)*
- **Let the works pause and answer the Network** — *Pause, faced.* She lets the works pause — and answers the Network instead of the paper, the squeeze faced as a challenge. *(The meeting keeps her purse and her standing both whole, and the defiance is the war's own language; but paused is paused, and the mason's men go unpaid while she plays the longer game.)*
> *(The game remembers the choice, and the means: the purse, the standing, or the pause. The destination was never in doubt. The signature is hers.)*

scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — THE CALL ANSWERED (how she answers the callers' demand on Julian's paper: buy it back quietly, stand surety publicly, or refuse to be drawn). The cost is the material; decide the answering's shape. (Turns: 3 — the decision)
scenes.prose:
> *(The war room, midday: the packet, the map, the call's three roads. The obligations called at once; the fellow squeezed to reach her.)*
> "Answer it the way you answered the squeeze, child — in daylight, as yourself. But the answering is the question." — Augusta (the Dowager's whole counsel, delivered standing, the spectacles already risen)
> *(Three roads. The cost is the material, the midday the weather, the answering continues — but the means are hers to choose. She prices them: the buying — buy the paper back quietly through Quill, the fellow never knowing the danger passed so near; the surety — stand surety publicly, her name on his family's obligations, the ton witnessing the shield; the refusal — refuse to be drawn, let the fellow fight his own fight, the pride honored and the lever left in his hands. Each road answers the call. Each seasons the cost differently.)*
*★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — The call answered:*
- **Buy the paper back quietly through Quill** — *Bought, quiet.* She buys the obligations back through her solicitor — the fellow never knowing how near the danger passed. *(The answering keeps his name clean and his pride untouched, and the Network learns its lever can be lifted; but quiet is quiet, and a bought lever teaches the buyer nothing about the hand that lifted it.)*
- **Stand surety publicly, her name on the paper** — *Surety, stood.* She stands surety in the open — her name beside his family's on the obligations, the ton witnessing. *(The answering shows the shield entire, and the fellow knows exactly who stands with him; but open is open, and the standing spent is the standing risked — hers now, beside his.)*
- **Refuse to be drawn; let him fight his own fight** — *Refused, his.* She refuses the lever — the fellow's fight is the fellow's, the pride honored whole. *(The answering keeps her war from becoming his debt, and the refused is the respect his pride is owed; but refused is refused, and the callers will squeeze the unshielded man without mercy.)*
> *(The game remembers the choice, and the means: the bought, the surety, or the refused. The destination was never in doubt. The signature is hers.)*

She prices them: the paying — pay the week's tradesmen first, honoring the household's own debts before the campaign's; the holding — hold the household's purse close, the week's money kept entire; the spending — spend on the house's standing, where the house must be seen standing. scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — THE SQUEEZE, MET (how the restoration's financing meets the pressure: pay the obligations honestly and publicly, hold the purse tight, or spend standing to be seen funded). The stillroom is the material; decide the financing's road. (Turns: 3 — the decision)
scenes.prose:
> *(The stillroom, midday. The week's book lies open, the tradesmen's letters in their neat damning row, and the financing's road waiting to be chosen. Mrs. Pye stands at her book and does not look away — the household's arithmetic is her own, and she does not flinch from it.)*
> "Pay them, hold the purse, or spend the standing, miss. The tradesmen won't wait forever, and the houses behind them won't wait at all." — Mrs. Pye
> *(Three roads, and the midday light on the stillroom table to see them by. Pay the obligations honestly and publicly — the tradesmen paid in daylight, where the ton can watch the paying. Hold the household's purse tight — the money kept entire against whatever the larger does next. Spend the house's standing to be seen funded — unshaken, unhurried, the squeeze answered in posture. Each road meets the squeeze. Each meets it differently.)*
*★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — The squeeze, met:*
- **Pay the obligations publicly** — *Paid, in daylight.* She pays the restoration's tradesmen honestly and where the ton can see the paying — the honest debts honored first, in the open. *(Clean credit is quiet strength, and the house's name stays clean; but the campaign eats too, and the larger's next move will find the purse thinner.)*
- **Hold the purse tight** — *Held, entire.* She holds the household's money close — the purse kept entire against what the larger does next. *(Room to maneuver is its own coin, and the holding buys it; but a held purse pays no tradesmen, and unpaid tradesmen talk.)*
- **Spend to be seen funded** — *Spent, seen.* She spends the house's standing where the ton must see it standing — unshaken, unhurried, funded. *(The ton believes what it sees unbent, and unbendable is believed; but standing is coin, and the week's coin is finite.)*
> *(The game remembers the choice, and the financing: the paid, the held, or the spent. The road is chosen. The choosing was hers.)*

scenes.synopsis: the fellow victim — the bought obligations; Julian fears for her, not for the plan. (Turns: 8)

> (T2 · tone) *Gentle — "You know it too well, Julian"; dry — "Kid gloves, everywhere this week"; direct — "Tell me what the grip does next."* — remembered: *The telling, asked for plainly.*
> "What it does next is what it always does. It finds the softest thing you love and leans on it." He turns from the window. "I am asking you to be careful. Not the plan. You." — Julian

> (T4 · dialogue) *"I am careful, Julian."; "Careful is a luxury the war doesn't stock."; "You fear for me — say it plainly, then."* — remembered: *Plainness, requested.*
> "I fear for you. Plainly." His voice does not rise. "These people unmade my family with paper and patience, and you are walking straight at them with a ledger." — Julian

scenes.synopsis: the agent's report — the London face moves through cutouts; paper, agents, consequences. (Turns: 8)

> "The London face hasn't shown himself, miss. He doesn't need to. The banking houses tighten, the paper moves, and his name is nowhere — which is the name's whole work." — Silas

> (T4 · dialogue) *"Buying our paper — to what end?"; "The third hands — whose are they?"; "And the London face — what does he want next?"* — remembered: *The ends, sought.*

scenes.synopsis: the question, first asked — what is the war for; the painter's precision, unsparing. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(The studio. Octavia is at her canvas, and the canvas is Rose — or rather, becoming Rose, which is more alarming. The painter works without looking up.)*
> "You are preparing something, Rose. I can see it in the set of your shoulders. Tell me what it is for." — Octavia
> (T1 · look closer) *The canvas — becoming her, alarming; the shoulders — set, and seen; the working — no looking up, precision's own courtesy.* — remembered: *The seeing, noted.*
> (T2 · tone) *"The war is for the Park, Octavia" — plain; "For the account, stated" — the campaigner; "You tell me — you see so clearly" — the deflection, tried honestly.* — remembered: *The deflection, attempted.*
> "I see a woman assembling a weapon. Weapons need purposes, or they become ornaments." She looks up at last. "Is it vengeance?" — Octavia
> (T3 · remembered micro-decision) *Hear the weapon — assembling, and seen; hear the ornament — what a purposeless weapon becomes; hear the question — vengeance, asked outright.* — remembered: *The asking, heard.*
> (T4 · dialogue) *"It is not vengeance, Octavia."; "It is the account — stated, and ended."; "What would you have it be?"* — remembered: *The answering, begun.*
> "I would have it be something you can say aloud at the end. Vengeance curdles in the keeping." Octavia sets down her palette. "Say the purpose now, or it will choose itself." — Octavia
> (T5 · look closer) *The curdling — vengeance, kept too long; the choosing — what purposes do when no one is watching; the aloud — the saying, at the end.* — remembered: *The warning, filed.*
> (T6 · stance) *She honors Octavia's question, faces the canvas, and admits she is still searching for the purpose.* — remembered: *Octavia's question, honored.*
> (T7 · social maneuver) *Promise the saying — the purpose, aloud, at the end; take the precision — the painter's, unsparing; keep the question — asked, open, owed an answer.* — remembered: *The promise, made.*
> (T8 · remembered micro-decision) *Keep Octavia — thirty-four, precise, unsparing; keep the canvas — becoming, hers; keep the question — the war's, the for.* — remembered: *Octavia, kept.*
> *(Octavia returns to her canvas, and the brush moves with the certainty of a woman who has said the necessary thing and will not say it twice. Rose sits for another quarter hour, thinking about weapons and ornaments, and about purposes that choose themselves when no one is watching.)*
> *The studio smells of turpentine and truth. The question hangs in it like a wet canvas — what is the war for — drying slowly, impossible to hurry.*

scenes.synopsis: the war room — the library; the account's shape; the house's paper memory. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(The library. The house's paper memory, and this week it has become her war room in truth — the long table cleared, the account's papers in honest stacks, the de Valcourt trail mapped in her own hand. The records remember. She has learned to ask them properly.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *The table — cleared, and the war room's; the stacks — honest, the account's; the map — her hand, the de Valcourt trail.* — remembered: *The room, taken.*
> (T2 · remembered micro-decision) *Lay out the account — what they did, in paper; lay out the wanting — what they want, in paper; lay out her terms — in her own hand, beside both.* — remembered: *The laying, done.*
> *(She works the way she has learned to: patiently, from paper. The émigré notes, the banking houses' quiet tightening, the scattered Hartwell paper being bought through third hands — the money's map, drawn in the library that remembers every ledger the house ever kept.)*
> (T3 · stance) *Scholar enough to be patient with paper, general enough to work the map, Hartwell enough to trust the house's memory.* — remembered: *The working, begun.*
> (T4 · tone) *Quiet — the paper's own register; dry — "The records remember, and so do I"; steady — the map, being drawn.* — remembered: *Steadiness, kept.*
> (T5 · look closer) *The notes — émigré, moving quiet; the houses — banking, tightening; the buying — careful, through third hands.* — remembered: *The map, drawn.*
> (T6 · social maneuver) *Ask the paper properly; keep the house's memory; use the patience she has spent a season learning.* — remembered: *Patience, used.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *Keep the account — stated, papered; keep the wanting — the Park's, named; keep the terms — her own, handwritten.* — remembered: *The account, kept.*
> (T8 · choice) *Answer in the ton's rooms — the Assembly, conceived; answer in paper — the ledgers, quietly; answer in both — the war's whole register.* — remembered: *The answering, shaped.*
> *(The library darkens around her as the afternoon goes, and the lamps are lit, and the war room glows like a held breath. The account lies in its stacks — what they did, what they want — and beside it, in her own hand, the beginning of her terms. The shape of an answer is forming. She can feel it the way one feels weather.)*
> *The lamps burn, the paper waits, and the house's memory keeps its patient watch over the woman at the long table — the answer, taking shape.*

scenes.synopsis: the sealed things — the banker's letter, the hall-tray note, the unknown-sealed letter; the discipline honored. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> *(The war room's drawer. Three sealed things rest in it, each in its honest place: the banker's letter, sealed; the hall-tray note, sealed on its tray; the unknown-sealed letter, unopened since the fourteenth week's tray. The schedule has not yet required any of them. The discipline is entire.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *The drawer — the war room's, honest; the three — sealed, placed; the schedule — not yet requiring, and trusted.* — remembered: *The discipline, seen.*
> (T2 · remembered micro-decision) *Touch none — the seals, kept; count none — the unopened, honored; trust the schedule — the not-yet, entire.* — remembered: *The touching, refused.*
> *(Some weeks the sealed things feel like cowardice, and some weeks like patience. This is a patience week. The account she is building needs no more paper than it has; the sealed things keep their own counsel, and she keeps hers.)*
> (T3 · stance) *She honors the seals, trusts the paper she already holds, and chooses patience on purpose.* — remembered: *The choosing, done.*
> (T4 · tone) *Quiet — the seals' own register; dry — "Not yet is also an answer"; steady — the discipline, entire.* — remembered: *The answer, named.*
> (T5 · look closer) *The banker's — the letter, sealed; the hall-tray's — the note, trayed; the unknown — the fourteenth week's, unopened.* — remembered: *The three, honored.*

> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *Keep the seals — entire, kept; keep the schedule — the not-yet, trusted; keep the patience — this week's, chosen.* — remembered: *The seals, kept.*
> *(She closes the drawer the way one closes a prayer book — gently, and meaning to open it again. The sealed things rest in the dark, keeping their counsel. Some weeks the war is fought with opened letters. This week it is fought with sealed ones.)*
> *The drawer clicks shut. The war room holds its three small silences — sealed, trayed, unopened — like heartbeats under the floorboards, patient and entire.*

scenes.synopsis: Drummond's shadow — the held £5,000 looms larger; near the money, never her person. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(The drawing room, afternoon. Letitia has the morning's financial intelligence, and her brightness has the particular edge it gets when the news concerns Lady Agatha Drummond — who does not appear, has not appeared, will not appear, but whose shadow is doing a great deal of appearing on her behalf.)*
> "The £5,000 sits where it sat, darling. But its shadow has moved nearer the restoration's money — a whisper at the banking house, a question asked twice. She never comes herself. She sends the weather." — Letitia
> (T1 · look closer) *The sitting — where it sat, held; the moving — nearer, the shadow's; the weather — sent, and hers.* — remembered: *The weather, read.*
> (T2 · tone) *"She sends the weather — and the weather is tightening" — dry; "The installment — held, entire?"; "What does the whisper want, Aunt?"* — remembered: *The wanting, asked.*
> "The whisper wants us to remember it is there, darling. Held installments are like held breaths — everyone in the room starts breathing to their rhythm." — Letitia
> (T3 · remembered micro-decision) *Hear the rhythm — the room's, breathing to hers; hear the held — the breath, the installment; price the remembering — she wants to be remembered.* — remembered: *The rhythm, heard.*
> (T4 · dialogue) *"Then we breathe our own rhythm, Aunt."; "Let her hold it — we hold the Park."; "The shadow lengthens — so does the day."* — remembered: *The answering, begun.*
> "Good, darling. That is the only possible answer to weather." Letitia folds the intelligence away. "She will not call it — not yet. Calling it ends the leverage. She wants the looming." — Letitia
> (T5 · look closer) *The folding — the intelligence, away; the leverage — in the looming, not the calling; the calling — not yet, because calling ends it.* — remembered: *The looming, priced.*
> (T6 · stance) *She trusts her aunt's reading, watches the shadow, and holds the Park.* — remembered: *The holding, done.*
> (T7 · social maneuver) *Steady the room — breathe the household's own rhythm; price the shadow — the looming, entire; thank the reader — the aunt, bright and exact.* — remembered: *Steadiness, kept.*
> (T8 · remembered micro-decision) *Keep the installment — held, the £5,000; keep the shadow — near, lengthening; keep the person — absent, as always, as required.* — remembered: *The absence, noted.*
> *(Letitia rings for tea, finished with weather for the day. The £5,000 sits where it sat — held, entire, looming — and its shadow does Lady Agatha's appearing for her: present everywhere, accountable nowhere.)*
> *The tea comes, the shadow stays, and Rose drinks to the held installment with the respect one reserves for loaded guns nobody has picked up yet.*

scenes.synopsis: the war-room working dress — chosen by her own hand; 3 diegetic options, no coin cost. (Turns: 8)

scenes.synopsis: duty against love — no legal shape to this war; loving her into an open fight is the test of him. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(The morning room. Henry has the particular stillness of a soldier considering ground that will not hold a formation — no magistrate to carry this war to, no regulation that covers it, no honorable shape at all.)*

> (T2 · tone) *Gentle — "Then we draw our own lines, Henry"; dry — "The law is a map — this war is the territory"; direct — "What does duty say, when the law is silent?"* — remembered: *The saying, asked.*

> (T3 · remembered micro-decision) *Hear the order — the hardest, taken; hear the standing — beside the unreachable; hear the eyes — meeting hers, not flinching.* — remembered: *The taking, heard.*
> (T4 · dialogue) *"Then stand, Henry."; "The hardest orders are the honorable ones."; "You frighten me a little — thank you."* — remembered: *The thanking, done.*
> "I frighten myself a little." The ghost of a smile, there and gone. "A Beaumont does not say that twice in a year." — Henry
> (T5 · look closer) *The ghost — a smile's, once a year; the frightening — admitted, his own; the twice — not done, and noted.* — remembered: *The admission, kept.*
> (T6 · stance) *She honors the order, uses the standing it gives her, and thanks the man who frightens on her behalf.* — remembered: *The order, honored.*
> (T7 · social maneuver) *Take his stand — the beside, offered; give him ground — lines, drawn by hand; keep the soldier — honorable, entire.* — remembered: *The soldier, kept.*
> (T8 · remembered micro-decision) *Keep Henry — thirty-three, tested; keep the duty — set against the love; keep the order — the hardest, his.* — remembered: *Henry, kept.*
> *(He bows — the soldier's bow, formal even in a morning room — and leaves her with the particular quiet of a man who has just volunteered for a war with no uniform. Loving her into an open fight is the test of him. He has taken the order.)*

scenes.synopsis: the Frenchman's fear — the de Valcourts are his world; her English directness terrifies him. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(The drawing room, late afternoon. Laurent is all polish, which today means all armor — the French instinct, fully deployed: survive beautifully, fight later, never name the thing at the table.)*
> "You are going to name them, Rose. In a room. Aloud." He says it the way one mentions a duel at breakfast. "My family has survived three regimes by never doing exactly that." — Laurent
> (T1 · look closer) *The polish — all of it, armor; the instinct — French, deployed; the regimes — three, survived by silence.* — remembered: *The instinct, seen.*
> (T2 · tone) *"I am not naming the Network, Laurent" — careful; "Three regimes — and now the Hartwells?" — dry; "Your fear is showing, mon ami" — fond, because it is.* — remembered: *The showing, named.*
> "My fear is *always* showing, chérie. It is my best feature." The smile does not reach his eyes. "The de Valcourts are my world. You are asking me to watch you set fire to the weather." — Laurent
> (T3 · remembered micro-decision) *Hear the feature — the best, the fear; hear the world — his, the de Valcourts'; hear the fire — the weather's, about to be set.* — remembered: *The feature, heard.*
> (T4 · dialogue) *"I ask nothing of you, Laurent."; "Then stand clear of the weather."; "Your world and mine are at war. I know."* — remembered: *The knowing, said.*
> "You ask nothing. That is the terror of you." He takes her hand — the polish cracking, just there, at the edges. "An Englishwoman asks nothing and does everything." — Laurent
> (T5 · look closer) *The cracking — at the edges, just visible; the hand — taken, hers; the terror — hers, English, total.* — remembered: *The crack, glimpsed.*
> (T6 · stance) *She honors his fear, does everything that can be done, and asks nothing in return.* — remembered: *His fear, honored.*
> (T7 · social maneuver) *Steady him — the weather, watched together; spare him — the standing-clear, offered; keep him — fearful, entire.* — remembered: *The sparing, offered.*
> (T8 · remembered micro-decision) *Keep Laurent — thirty-one, terrified; keep the world — his, the de Valcourts'; keep the directness — hers, English, non-negotiable.* — remembered: *Laurent, kept.*
> *(He kisses her hand with the formality of a man saying goodbye to something, and she understands — with the cold clarity these weeks have taught her — that her English directness terrifies him the way weather terrifies sailors: not because it is cruel, but because it cannot be negotiated with.)*
> *The drawing room holds his polish a moment after he goes — the armor, the fear, the best feature showing — and the afternoon goes on being beautiful, which is the French answer to everything.*

scenes.synopsis: the solvent ritual — direction + occasion brief, 20 micro-decisions, story morsels between pins, reveal coda. (Turns: 21)
scenes.prose:
> **Occasion brief (published):** "The cost's weight. The restoration's financing is squeezed, the tradesmen's terms are early and polite, and Rose will meet the ton's creditors' eyes the way the ton must see her meet them: severe, solvent, unhurried. The dress code: severe, solvent propriety — nothing to doubt, nothing to pity, nothing that reaches for glitter or apology. The dress must carry the week in a single line: the squeeze, answered in cloth. Mourning colors forbidden; gloves expected. **Editorial criterion: solvency.**"
>
> **A. The Ledger** — dark and severe; the account's own cloth. Motif: ruled lines, worked in black silk at cuff and hem — the ledger, embroidered. Thread: **black silk** (the severe, stated) / **charcoal** (the severe, softened) / **ink-blue** (the severe, deepened). Colorway: near-black + charcoal + ink-blue. Accessories: no ribbon at the throat — the severe, unadorned; small jet earrings; dark kid gloves.
> **B. The Hartwell** — the house's palette; sober, landed, unbowed. Motif: the Hartwell oak sprig, restrained at cuff and hem. Thread: **gold** (the landed, stated) / **copper** (the Park's autumn) / **matching silk** (the sober, exact). Colorway: deep green + Hartwell blue + cream. Accessories: the Hartwell blue ribbon; pearl drop earrings; a simple gold pendant; cream kid gloves.
> **C. The Unpurchased** — plain muslin, unimpeachable; nerve without ornament. Motif: plain hem, honest seams — the unpurchased, unstated. Thread: **self** (the plain, exact) / **dove silk** (the plain, lifted) / **ivory whitework** (the plain, lit). Colorway: dove grey + ivory + undyed muslin. Accessories: no jewels — the throat, plain and unbought; grey kid gloves; a simple muslin fichu.
>
> *(System: commit to a direction — remembered for the week's creditors and callers. Then the pins begin. Each pin costs 5 coins; no Crown SKUs; jewels from owned pieces only, never a ritual step.)*
>
> (T1 · choice — the direction) *She commits: A, B, or C — the week's thesis, remembered.*
>
> **Pin 1 (T2 · micro-decision) — Dress silhouette:** the solvent line — empire, severe; nothing in the cut that doubts. *5 coins.*

scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 2/3 — THE ANSWER'S SHAPE (how she will answer the squeeze: state the account at the Assembly publicly, answer the Network in kind through paper and pressure, or hold silence and let the work speak). The drawing room is the material; decide the answer's shape — the Assembly address conceived. (Turns: 3 — the decision)
scenes.prose:
> *(The drawing room, night. The week's intelligence gathered, the account's shape forming, the answer's shape still to be chosen. Letitia sets down her cup — the household has measured the squeeze all week, and the measuring wants a face.)*
> "Answer them, darling. But answer where it counts — the ton's rooms, the paper's columns, or the quiet. The squeeze wants a reaction. Give it an answer instead." — Letitia
> *(Three roads, and the night to choose among them. The Assembly — state the account publicly, in the ton's own rooms, solvency reported like doctrine where the creditors read the ton's face. The kind — answer the Network in kind, through paper and pressure, Silas's boys and Quill's clerks fighting the quiet war. The silence — hold silence and let the work speak, the restoration rising stone by stone while the squeeze spends itself on quiet. Each road answers. Each answers differently.)*
*★ KEY DECISION 2/3 — The answer's shape:*
- **State it at the Assembly** — *Stated, in public.* She will state the account in the ton's own rooms — her solvency reported, her nerve priced, where the whole town hears it. *(A room cannot unsay what it hears, and the creditors read the ton's face; but a public answer is a public target, and the larger will aim.)*
- **Answer in kind** — *Answered, in paper.* She answers through paper and pressure — Silas's watch, Quill's law, the quiet war fought in kind. *(The Network's own ground is ground, and ground is advantage; but the quiet war is the Network's native country, and she would be fighting uphill.)*
- **Hold silence** — *Held, and working.* She holds silence and lets the work speak — the restoration rising, the household steady, the squeeze spending itself. *(Denied reactions curdle, and the squeeze gets no reaction; but silence reads as fear to the ton, and the ton's face is the creditors' ledger.)*
> *(The game remembers the choice, and the answer: the stated, the kind, or the held. The road is chosen. The choosing was hers.)*

The shape, obliquely — the Network's outline drawn in the air, the ton smelling what it cannot name. Her terms, no names — the terms standing alone, clean of weather, the room given the what without the who. Each road speaks. Each speaks differently.)*
*★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — The account's language:*
- **Her solvency, plainly** — *Stated, plain.* She states her solvency the way a bishop states doctrine — the account plain, the nerve priced, the room hearing money. *(The plain carries furthest in a room, and the furthest is the creditors' ledger; but plain solvency invites plain questions, and questions have edges.)*
- **The shape, obliquely** — *Shaped, sideways.* She names the Network's shape without its name — the outline drawn, the weather described, the ton smelling what it cannot prove. *(The oblique lets the room do the naming, and the room loves its own cleverness; but clever rooms invent freely, and inventions wander.)*
- **Her terms, no names** — *Termed, clean.* She states her terms with no names at all — the what without the who, the terms standing clean of weather. *(Clean terms ask for clean answers, and the room respects the clean; but the unnamed weather still blows, and the room may not dress for it.)*
> *(The game remembers the choice, and the language: the plain, the oblique, or the clean. The road is chosen. The choosing was hers.)*

options.detail: *Counted road.* Send the establishment first — the household and the papers ahead, the principal following when the ground is ready. *(The counted road is the sending's, and sending prepares ground; but the prepared ground is the waited one, and the waited may be watched.)*

options.label: Stay
options.detail: *Quiet road.* Stay and hold London — the door kept open, the departure delayed, the war watched from the capital. *(The quiet road is the staying's, and staying holds ground; but the held ground is the kept one, and the kept may be besieged.)*
